name:
The Lodge at Woodloch
Meals & More Included
insider_take: This award-winning destination spa resort sits on 500 pristine acres in Pennsylvania's Pocono Mountains, where wellness meets luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The Lodge at Woodloch is consistently ranked among the world's best destination spas, featuring a 40,000-square-foot spa facility with unique treatments like forest bathing and crystal healing. The property operates as an all-inclusive wellness retreat with healthy gourmet cuisine, fitness classes, and activities all included. It's also home to the famous Woodloch Pines family resort next door, creating a unique multi-generational vacation option.
pro_tip: Book the Tree House spa treatment - it's the only treetop spa pavilion in North America, offering massages 15 feet above the forest floor with stunning lake views.
dont_miss: The morning meditation walks around pristine Lake Teedyuskung, the indoor/outdoor infinity pool that seems to blend into the forest, and the farm-to-table dining experience featuring ingredients from their own organic garden and local Pocono farms.
pros: Scenic lakefront location with nature activities
cons: Remote mountain location requires travel planning
This property is not available for online booking.
